items.name: Wireless Ray Tracing Datasets for Various Skyscrapers’ Environments
items.description: The dataset comprises a large number of entries, capturing various wireless communication scenarios modeled using transmitters placed on iconic structures such as the Burj Khalifa, One World Trade Center, Shanghai Tower, Warisan Merdeka Tower, and Willis Tower. These datasets are the output of wireless ray tracing simulations for Single Input Single Output (SISO) wireless connectivity, conducted in a real-world 3D digital twin environment created using MATLAB and the OpenStreetMap environment.
